data.body: Gerrit 2868 gate and submit evidence: exact reviewed patch-set SHA aabbed82e2ff97aab8e3e3dcdcba373e6c8897c2 earned LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with zero unresolved comments, then revision-scoped submit succeeded. Gerrit reports MERGED as server-side rebased revision d8ec7304c5f4ecbc318d8705db6714082b9a687a on parent f9343fcd56422e894be4dea90221e8c8edb4f885. Advisory disposition — accepted as a reviewer false positive, with direct Terraform evidence: evaluatingSTAbal sourceρακ"$$VAR" yields "$$VAR", while "$${VAR}" yields "${VAR}"; therefore Bash would interpret the former as PID plus VAR exactly as the retained comment states. No patch amendment was warranted.
